title: Quartile: a meaning-preserving Q1 academic writing engine with journal-editor simulation and statistics checks
description: Quartile edits business, management, finance and economics manuscripts toward the conventions of Q1 journals while keeping the science unchanged. A deterministic guard blocks any revision that adds or changes numbers, citations, protected constructs, names or causal claims. It includes a desk-rejection screen, a statcheck-style recomputation of reported test statistics and regression-table consistency checks, reference cross-checks, a journal-editor and reviewer simulation, an idea-to-paper framing tool, and an MCP server that exposes the checks to Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients.
